players.product: VCSEL, DFB and EML laser chips and PIN photodiode chips for optical communication (InP / GaAs IDM, 6-inch line); high-power semiconductor laser chips

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 39,102.39 ten-thousand, up 82.67% year on year, mainly from rapid growth of the optical communication business laid out earlier; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 3,033.78 ten-thousand (company: from operating improvement and valuation gains of its photonics fund); recurring net profit RMB -1,038.44 ten-thousand. Operating cash flow fell RMB 12,903.85 ten-thousand year on year as optical communication revenue rose sharply and inventory stocking increased.

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: Everbright has formed a four-category optical communication chip matrix - VCSEL, DFB, EML and PIN - aimed at the current industry shortage of optical chips; its optical communication orders are in batch delivery and it is continuing to expand capacity to meet customers' growing demand. An in-research project develops new-generation high-performance, low-power optical communication chips for AI data-center optical transmission.

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: Everbright runs an IDM flow (design, epitaxy, wafer process, cleave/coat, packaging and test) on 2-inch, 3-inch and 6-inch laser chip lines - company: the 6-inch line is the largest in the industry - across five material systems (GaAs, InP, GaN, SiC, silicon photonics); its InP platform serves optical communication and already supplies both transmit-end and receive-end products.

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: its 9XXnm 50W high-power laser chip (330μm emitter, efficiency at least 62%) is in large-volume production and shipment (company: the highest-power volume semiconductor laser chip on the market); a dual-junction single-emitter chip set a 132W room-temperature CW record; multi-junction VCSEL efficiency reached 74%.

Everbright Photonics.why: IDM semiconductor laser chip maker supplying VCSEL / DFB / EML / PIN optical communication chips into the optical module chain; H1 2026 revenue +82.67% on its optical communication business.
Everbright Photonics.evidence: Everbright Photonics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026): VCSEL, DFB, EML and PIN optical communication chip matrix, orders in batch delivery, capacity being expanded; revenue +82.67% mainly from optical communication.
